why: Muralista's page is served from here rather than from a folder the user points at. Pregonero cannot guess where mapper.html is on a machine, and a setting that has to be discovered before anything works is the dead-end shape this redesign exists to remove. Vendoring by tag with a hash test is what already demotes warp.js from a fork to a cache, and it does the same here.
notVendored: media/ (90 MB of Muralista's own test clips) and white.html. They are its test content, not its page.
